name: web-dark-architecture-landing-with-oversized-cropped-title
title: Moody architecture site with a framed landscape hero and giant cropped background title
whatItIs: A black cover with tiny top labels, a framed browser-like hero showing a dark cabin in misty moorland with 'STONE DRIFT' in white and a small stats card at the bottom right, and an enormous dark-grey cropped word behind the frame.
whatItMeans: Quiet and cinematic; the frame and desaturated photo feel like a high-end property film.
techniques: Frame the hero as a screen within a black page.
Set a giant near-black word behind the frame so it barely shows.
Use desaturated landscape photography with tiny type.
Add slide dots at the bottom edge.
bestFor: Architecture, resort and premium property sites

vocabulary.definition: A hero image inset in a frame within the page.
Huge low-contrast type behind the main content.
